blocks.hero.subhead: One office in Louisville's Middletown area, serving Louisville, Elizabethtown, and Southern Indiana. Choose your area to see how it works for you.
blocks.request.heading: Ready to get started?
blocks.request.text: Request an appointment in about a minute, or call (502) 523-2970. Most people are seen the same week.
blocks.links.heading: Choose your area

links.items.title: Louisville, KY
links.items.text: In person at our Middletown office, or online anywhere in Kentucky. Switch between the two whenever you need to.

links.items.title: Elizabethtown, KY
links.items.text: Online with any Freedom counselor, or in person at our Louisville office, under an hour away. Many E-town clients do both.

links.items.title: Southern Indiana
links.items.text: About 20 minutes from New Albany, Jeffersonville, and Clarksville. Indiana clients meet in person at our Louisville office.
